task: ae.bigint.Big: arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic from scratch
reasoning_summary: Sign-magnitude base-2^32 limbs with schoolbook plus Karatsuba multiply and Knuth algorithm D division. Every operation is differential-tested against BigInteger, including extreme-limb operands that provably reach the add-back path (counter) and an exhaustive small-limb division grid. 12 of 15 mutants killed; the 3 survivors were analysed (2 equivalent, 1 gap fixed and then killed).
